name: Therapy
declaration: Inborn runs a language model on this device. Session notes you write here never leave it: there is no cloud, no account and no server. The model is not a clinician: it can misread risk, miss context and produce confident errors, so every note it drafts is yours to review before it enters a record. It must never replace your own risk assessment or a supervisor. Keep client identifiers out of prompts where your professional rules require it; client vaults, the audit log and signed exports document what happened on this device and are not a certification of confidentiality under any law.
